User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system, whether a member, leader, supervisor, or pastor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

hierarchy.description: Defines the user's position within the church hierarchy.

celulaId.description: The ID of the cell the user belongs to or leads.

supervisorId.description: The ID of the user's supervisor.

redeId.description: The ID of the network the user belongs to.

integrationStatus.description: The user's stage in the integration pipeline, differentiating between church and cell visitors.

gamification.description: Stores gamification data for the user, primarily for leaders.

lmsProgress.description: Tracks user's progress in different Learning Management System (LMS) tracks.

kidsData.description: Specific data for children, used for the Kids Cell module.

responsibleIds.description: Array of user IDs of parents or guardians.

restrictedPickup.description: Notes on who is restricted from picking up the child.

lastContactLog.description: Timestamp of the last contact with the user.

absenceCount.description: The number of times the user has been absent.

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: Represents a cell group within the church.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Cell entity.

nome.description: The name of the cell group.

liderId.description: Reference to User (Cell Leader). (Relationship: User 1:N Cell) The ID of the cell leader.

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor). (Relationship: User 1:N Cell) The ID of the supervisor overseeing the cell.

membros.description: References to Users. (Relationship: Cell 1:N User) An array of user IDs representing the members of the cell.

healthStats.description: Stores the calculated health score and related stats for the cell.

linkedKidsCellId.description: ID of the linked kids cell, if any.

AttendanceReport.title: AttendanceReport
AttendanceReport.description: Represents an attendance report for a cell meeting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AttendanceReport entity.

cellId.description: Reference to Cell. (Relationship: Cell 1:N AttendanceReport) The ID of the cell the report belongs to.

date.description: The date of the cell meeting.

presentMembers.description: References to Users. (Relationship: User N:N AttendanceReport) An array of user IDs representing the members present at the meeting.

visitantes.description: String with names and contact info of visitors.

conversoes.description: The number of conversions reported at the meeting.

LeaderTask.title: LeaderTask
LeaderTask.description: Represents a task assigned to a cell leader.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeaderTask entity.

liderId.description: Reference to User (Cell Leader). (Relationship: User 1:N LeaderTask) The ID of the cell leader assigned the task.

targetUserId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N LeaderTask) The ID of the member or visitor the task is related to.

message.description: The message associated with the task.

dueDate.description: The due date for the task.

DiscipleshipPlan.title: DiscipleshipPlan
DiscipleshipPlan.description: Represents a discipleship plan between a leader (mentor) and a member (disciple).

id.description: Unique identifier for the DiscipleshipPlan entity.

liderId.description: Reference to User (Mentor/Leader). (Relationship: User 1:N DiscipleshipPlan) The ID of the leader/mentor.

auxiliarId.description: Reference to User (Disciple). (Relationship: User 1:N DiscipleshipPlan) The ID of the member being discipled.

status.description: The status of the discipleship plan (e.g., 'identificado', 'demonstrando', 'delegando').

checklist.description: A checklist of development steps in the discipleship plan.

CultoRegistro.title: CultoRegistro
CultoRegistro.description: Represents a record of attendance and other details for a church service (culto).

id.description: Unique identifier for the CultoRegistro entity.

data.description: The date of the church service.

horario.description: The time of the church service.

adultos.description: The number of adults attending the service.

criancas.description: The number of children attending the service.

clima.description: The weather conditions during the service.

feriadoProximo.description: Indicates whether there was a holiday near the service date.

jogoFutebol.description: Indicates whether there was a soccer game during the service time.

serieMensagem.description: The message series being preached during the service.

apresentacaoBebe.description: Indicates whether there was a baby presentation during the service.

criadoEm.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

MemberNote.title: Member Note
MemberNote.description: Represents a note or log entry for a member, created by a leader.

authorId.description: The ID of the leader who created the note.

memberId.description: The ID of the member the note is about.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the ConectarGC application, focusing on managing church cell groups and member engagement. The core principle is Authorization Independence, achieved through path-based ownership for user-specific data and denormalization of authorization information (especially cell membership) where needed.

**Authorization Independence:**

*   **User-Owned Data:** Attendance reports and culto registros are stored under a user-specific path (`/cultos/{userId}`), granting straightforward ownership-based security. No `get()` calls are needed to verify user identity for their own data.
*   **Collaborative Data (Cells):** While cell data itself doesn't directly involve user-level access control in the provided schema, any subcollections related to collaborative activities within a cell (hypothetically, a `/cells/{cellId}/meeting_notes` collection) would require denormalization of the `membros` array from the `/cells/{cellId}` document into each meeting note. This eliminates the need for rules to fetch cell member lists to authorize write access.

**QAPs (Query Authorization Patterns):**

*   **Secure List Operations:** Path-based ownership (`/cultos/{userId}/registros`) inherently secures list operations. A user can only list their own culto registros.
*   **Role-Based Access Control:** The `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection enables secure role-based authorization, allowing only admins to manage certain data (e.g., creating global announcements, modifying cell structures).

**Structure Explanation:**

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores user profiles. The `role` field determines the user's privileges within the app. The `celulaId` field links users to their respective cells.
*   `/cells/{cellId}`: Represents cell groups. Contains the `liderId` and `supervisorId` for cell management. The `membros` array lists user IDs belonging to the cell.
*   `/attendance_reports/{reportId}`: Stores attendance reports for cell meetings. Includes `cellId`, `date`, `presentMembers`, and other relevant details.
*   `/leader_tasks/{taskId}`: Tracks tasks assigned to cell leaders. Includes information about the task type, target user, due date, and status.
*   `/discipleship_plans/{planId}`: Manages discipleship plans between leaders and members. Tracks the plan's status and development steps.
*   `/cultos/{userId}/registros/{registroId}`: Stores records of attendance and other details for church services, owned by each user. This nested structure ensures a user can only access their own records.

This structure balances security, scalability, and debuggability by adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates.
